title: e3: Learning to Explore Enables Extrapolation of Test-Time Compute for LLMs
authors_zh: Amrith Setlur、Matthew Y. R. Yang、Charlie Snell、Jeremy Greer、Ian Wu、Virginia Smith、Max Simchowitz、Aviral Kumar
paper_type_zh: 推理轨迹、搜索或测试时计算研究
best_for_zh: 需要审计 rollout、选择器、预算、数据谱系与复现边界的读者
one_line: e3 releases staged math prompt/ground-truth data, code, and a Qwen3-1.7B checkpoint for an 8k-to-16k GRPO curriculum, but not the grouped on-policy rollouts or per-trace advantages used during training.
该条目将推理轨迹、搜索选择或测试时计算作为可审计的研究对象；未披露字段已明确标为 unknown。
why: For rollout and test-time trace data, e3 makes group composition, failed-response gradients, task difficulty, and token budget part of the training-data contract; without the grouped traces, its central feedback mechanism cannot be fully replayed or audited.
inclusion_reason: e3 is directly relevant to rollout and test-time trace data because it treats each prompt as a budget-conditioned group of successful and failed responses whose relative advantages drive exploration, while the public release exposes only static prompt-level records and aggregate statistics.

title: Problem
问题
html: Models trained for long reasoning often stop benefiting when test-time output length exceeds their maximum training budget. e3 asks how post-training can teach a model to use extra tokens for in-context exploration - generating, checking, revising, or trying another hypothesis - rather than merely extending a single path. For this track, the operative data object is a prompt-conditioned group of sampled responses with outcome rewards and relative advantages under a specified token budget. The official datasets publish prompt-level static records and aggregate statistics, not those training-time groups.
面向长推理训练的模型，在测试时输出长度超过最大训练预算后，性能往往不再继续提升。e3 研究如何让后训练模型把额外 token 用于上下文内探索，例如生成、检查、修正或尝试另一种假设，而不只是延长单一路径。对本类别而言，实际的数据对象是：在给定 token 预算下，同一提示对应的一组采样回答、结果奖励及相对 advantage。官方数据集发布的是提示级静态记录与聚合统计，而不是这些训练时分组。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: e3 combines three ingredients: a base model with asymmetric competence such as stronger verification than generation, negative policy-gradient terms from incorrect rollouts that move probability away from failed traces, and a curriculum coupling problem difficulty with output budget. The recipe trains Qwen3-1.7B first on easy DMath prompts at 8k tokens and then on medium/hard prompts at 16k, aiming to make longer 32k inference traces chain more attempts and checks. The feedback remains binary final-answer correctness, and exploration emerges from group-relative optimization rather than released step labels.

e3 结合三个要素：基础模型在不同能力上存在不对称性，例如验证强于生成；错误 rollout 产生负的 policy-gradient 项，把概率质量从失败轨迹移开；以及把问题难度与输出预算耦合的 curriculum。该配方先在 8k token 预算下用 easy DMath 提示训练 Qwen3-1.7B，再在 16k 预算下用 medium/hard 提示继续训练，希望模型在 32k 推理时串联更多尝试与检查。反馈仍是最终答案的二元正确性，探索来自组相对优化，而不是已发布的步骤标签。

title: Method
方法
html: The official e3-math-easy and e3-math-medhard Parquet releases contain 12,853 and 2,500 rows. Each row stores a chat prompt, rule ground truth, solution field, scalar reward, aggregate length/correct_length/incorrect_length, and metadata; these are static prompt-level records, not the current policy's grouped trajectories. Training uses verL GRPO with vLLM, temperature 0.6, learning rate 1e-6, KL loss coefficient 0.001, and output budgets of 8192 then 16384 tokens. The custom scorer requires the closing think tag, extracts a final boxed answer, and applies MathD-style or SymPy equivalence for reward 1 versus 0. Stage 2 samples 32 responses per prompt and retains negative-advantage learning; stage-1 rollout count and some 8k hyperparameters conflict across paper prose, Table 5, and the released script.

官方 e3-math-easy 与 e3-math-medhard Parquet 分别包含 12,853 和 2,500 条记录。每条保存 chat prompt、rule ground truth、solution 字段、标量 reward、聚合的 length/correct_length/incorrect_length 及元数据；它们是提示级静态记录，不是当前策略生成的分组轨迹。训练采用 verL GRPO 与 vLLM，温度 0.6、学习率 1e-6、KL loss 系数 0.001，输出预算先为 8192、后为 16384 token。自定义 scorer 要求存在 think 结束标签，抽取最后一个 boxed answer，并通过 MathD 风格或 SymPy 等价判断返回 1 或 0。第二阶段每个提示采样 32 条回答并保留负 advantage 学习；第一阶段 rollout 数与部分 8k 超参数在论文正文、Table 5 和发布脚本之间存在冲突。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The paper reports that retaining negative gradients increases response diversity, verification attempts, length, and extrapolation in settings with a verification-generation gap, and that the coupled curriculum improves 32k evaluation after training only to 16k. Ablations and the released e3-1.7B checkpoint support the proposed recipe as an empirical method result. They do not show that every long trace is valid, that the static solution field is correctly sourced, or that the public data reconstruct the online feedback process. Artifact inspection verifies two training datasets, one 60-row HMMT/AIME 2025 test artifact, code, scorer, scripts, project page, and model, while confirming the absence of frozen grouped rollouts and per-trace advantages.

论文报告，在存在 verification-generation gap 的设置中，保留负梯度会提高回答多样性、验证尝试次数、长度及外推表现；只训练到 16k 时，耦合 curriculum 也能改善 32k 评测。消融实验与发布的 e3-1.7B checkpoint 支持该配方作为经验方法，但不能证明每条长轨迹都有效、静态 solution 字段来源正确，也不能证明公开数据足以重建在线反馈过程。工件核验确认了两个训练集、一个 60 条 HMMT/AIME 2025 测试集、代码、scorer、脚本、项目页与模型，同时确认未发布冻结的 grouped rollouts 和逐轨迹 advantage。

title: Novelty
新意
html: e3 does not introduce a new verifier or a separate search controller. Its contribution is to connect a rollout-level optimization effect - negative advantages on failed responses - with a staged data-and-budget curriculum so that the policy learns to implement exploration inside one long response. Unlike static SFT trace distillation, failed on-policy samples directly influence the next policy update; unlike ordinary fixed-budget GRPO, task difficulty and maximum response length change together. The novelty claim should therefore be evaluated at the feedback and curriculum contract, not inferred from benchmark rank.

e3 没有提出新的 verifier，也没有增加独立搜索控制器。它的贡献是把 rollout 级优化效应，即失败回答的负 advantage，与分阶段的数据-预算 curriculum 连接起来，使策略学会在一条长回答内部执行探索。不同于静态 SFT 轨迹蒸馏，失败的 on-policy 样本会直接影响下一次策略更新；不同于固定预算的普通 GRPO，任务难度与最大回答长度同步变化。因此，应从反馈契约与 curriculum 契约评价其新意，而不能由 benchmark 排名反推。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The static releases omit the grouped completions, per-response rewards and advantages, policy version, and update membership needed to replay the claimed negative-gradient mechanism. The solution field is frequently empty in inspected rows, and its nonempty values have unknown authorship and lineage. Stage-1 rollout.n is 8 in Table 5 and the 8k script but 16 in appendix prose; the released 8k script also differs from Table 5 in entropy coefficient and mini-batch size. Boxed-answer checking can accept invalid intermediate reasoning or fail on formatting/equivalence edge cases. Dataset licenses, record-level DeepScaleR provenance, decontamination, and train-test overlap controls are unknown, and reported benchmark gains cannot establish data quality.

静态发布缺少复现负梯度机制所需的 grouped completions、逐回答 reward 与 advantage、策略版本以及进入更新的成员关系。核验样本中 solution 字段经常为空，非空内容的作者与谱系也为 unknown。第一阶段 rollout.n 在 Table 5 和 8k 脚本中为 8，但附录正文写为 16；发布的 8k 脚本在 entropy coefficient 与 mini-batch size 上也不同于 Table 5。boxed-answer 检查可能接受中间推理无效的答案，也可能在格式或等价性边界上失败。数据集许可证、逐记录 DeepScaleR 来源、去污染和训练-测试重叠控制均为 unknown，报告的 benchmark 提升不能证明数据质量。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: For Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data, e3 provides a concrete design for studying how failed and successful response groups, task difficulty, and token budgets jointly affect RLVR exploration. Reuse can compare fixed versus coupled curricula or positive-only versus full GRPO, but should log every completion, reward, normalized advantage, truncation flag, policy checkpoint, and update membership. The public Parquet files are useful as staged prompt/ground-truth inputs and aggregate difficulty metadata after provenance and rights review; they must not be described as a released corpus of the online grouped rollouts.

对 Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data 类别而言，e3 提供了一个具体设计，可研究失败与成功回答分组、任务难度和 token 预算如何共同影响 RLVR 探索。复用者可以比较固定与耦合 curriculum，或只用正 advantage 与完整 GRPO，但应记录每条 completion、reward、归一化 advantage、截断标记、策略 checkpoint 及更新成员关系。公开 Parquet 在完成来源和权利审查后，可作为分阶段的提示-ground-truth 输入与聚合难度元数据，但不能被描述为已发布的在线 grouped rollout 语料。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Treat e3-math-easy and e3-math-medhard as static prompt-level releases, not grouped on-policy rollout corpora.
  • Audit the exact 8k configuration because rollout count, entropy coefficient, and mini-batch size differ across paper and script.
  • Reproduce the closing think tag and boxed-answer MathD/SymPy scorer before relying on binary rewards.
  • Log failed traces and their normalized advantages; they are central to the claimed exploration mechanism.
  • Separate curriculum, rollout count, off-policy reuse, and inference budget from dataset-quality claims.

• 将 e3-math-easy 与 e3-math-medhard 视为提示级静态发布，而不是 grouped on-policy rollout 语料。
  • 审计准确的 8k 配置，因为 rollout 数、entropy coefficient 和 mini-batch size 在论文与脚本间不一致。
  • 在依赖二元奖励前，复现对 think 结束标签 与 boxed answer 的 MathD/SymPy scorer。
  • 记录失败轨迹及其归一化 advantage，因为它们是论文所称探索机制的核心。
  • 将 curriculum、rollout 数、off-policy 复用和推理预算与数据质量主张分开。
